notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Farmstead Gleaner.
Farmstead Gleaner does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Elemental tokens, adding {2}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
